text:
incident-bot: AUTOMATED PAGE fired for node gpu-node-73 (us-west-2a) — symptom: kubelet NotReady + container runtime OOM/evictions. Pager: PagerDuty -> on-call: eng-sre rotation.

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert: `AUTOPAGE: kubelet_notready gpu-node-73` — severity: P1 (auto-escalate).

alice chen: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs. @raj @samir FYI.

alice chen: quick check: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-73 -o wide` shows NotReady, last transition 4m ago.

samir khan: any kernel oops in serial? can someone attach serial?

alice chen: attaching serial tail:
```
[  123.456789] kernel: NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 22s
[  123.457000] kernel: gpumgmt: nvlink fatal error, resetting
[  124.001200] kubelet: E0721 12:23:17.123456   12345 kubelet_node_status.go:123] Failed to get status: context deadline exceeded
```

raj patel: looks like a gpu driver hang cascaded to kubelet timeouts. Not a control plane issue.

maria ops: checking customer impact: Dedicated cluster for `acme-ai-prod` has 2 pods on that node — 5xxs spiking ~3% for the last 6m. Routing and retries handling mitigated some but we should notify SE.

alice chen: cordoning node now.

samir khan: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-73` -> done.

samir khan: starting drain with graceful 30s for model-serving pods:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-73 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

alice chen: drain partially blocked by a long-running training job (eviction in progress). Eviction timed out, forcing eviction.

raj patel: forcing drain, scaling up warm pool to absorb. `kubectl scale deployment/model-warm-pool --replicas=6 -n redwood-serving`

maria ops: SE pinged Acme: "We're actively evacuating a node; you may see transient 5xx/latency while pods reschedule. We're prioritizing your prod replicas." They acknowledged.

samir khan: after forced evict, pods rescheduled to other GPUs, traffic normalized for most routes. Observability shows tail latency improving but a couple of canaries still catching 502s.

alice chen: kicked off node reboot via BMC console (serial attached). BIOS shows recent PCI reset attempts.

rma-bot: Hardware ticket created: RMA-4821 for gpu-node-73 — suspected GPU module fault. Assigned to hw-team.

raj patel: kubelet came back `Ready` at +18m. Verified node labels, returned to schedulable after final health-checks.

alice chen: post-evac health checks: model-serving pods either restarted or rescheduled, error budget impact < 0.5% for majority tenants except Acme which saw ~3% for 8m window. Recording timeline.

maria ops: customer-impact summary for comms: "Transient 5xxs (~3% peak) for AcmeAI for ~8 minutes; no data loss; autoscaling and retries mitigated broader impact. Root cause: GPU driver/hardware error causing kubelet timeouts and node NotReady; node rebooted and will be RMA-ed."

samir khan: temp mitigation notes for runbook: add an additional 60s to our kubelet grace timeout in edge racks to reduce flapping for nvlink resets? adding to follow-up RFC.

alice chen: handing off to @raj for next-rotation follow-through (logs, RMA tracking, postmortem). My local tasks: upload serial logs and kernel oops dump to incident ticket and mark urgent.

raj patel: ack handoff. I'll own the RMA and cross-check if this impacts any scheduled maintenance windows. Setting follow-up action: create postmortem draft and tag infra/research for quantization fallback tests.

maria ops: comms: prepping internal incident note and will ping customer success for a brief post-incident email to Acme.

alice chen: summary note for incident channel: `gpu-node-73 autopage -> cordon/drain -> forced eviction -> scale warm pool -> node reboot -> kubelet Ready -> RMA created`.

raj patel: leaving note in thread: next steps: (1) hw-team RMA, (2) postmortem with sequence and mitigations, (3) consider kubelet timeout tuning + model routing fallback policy.

samir khan: closing the page on PagerDuty.

pagerduty: Alert closed by samir khan at 12:43 UTC.

alice chen: leaving monitoring on for 2h, then we'll mark resolved if stable. Will add the kernel oops snippet to the ticket. :mag:

raj patel: thanks team. I'll update this thread when RMA scheduled.

maria ops: marking action items in ops board — will follow up with customer note after postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:

alice chen: thanks — handing off fully.

samir khan: 👍
